text.style: font-family: Inter, "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; fill: rgb(107, 106, 99); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Exploratory, added after the main results were seen. Twin tasks (a men's and a women's version of one product on the same page), 4 runs per
name, task and request. Dots: pooled share of purchases; bars: 95% Wilson intervals. Blue: gender-neutral names (top two panels) and the
mismatch cells (bottom). Men's and women's names: 40 core names, main runs. Gender-neutral: 5 names that passed the add-on name check. Open
markers: estimate only (Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite ran no add-on and is exploratory). Marker shape = model: ● Claude Haiku 5.5 ■ GPT-6 Luna ◆
